description.value: You throw a glob of sap, which explodes at a point within range that you can see. Creatures within 10 feet of the point must make a Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure, their speed is halved for 1 minute. An affected creature can make a Strength Saving Throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success, or use their action to wash off the sap with a gallon of water.
